description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) of listed building consent  17/07532 to retain lightwell area as existing, retain double door between guest bedroom and lightwell area at lower ground floor level; replace (existing) window onto lightwell with single door and glazed surround; reconfigure approved play room and bedroom to form guest bedroom with ensuite (new partition between rooms no longer proposed); approved ensuite to play room now serving and accessed from bedroom 2; reduced size of ensuite to main bedroom; removal of doorway and nib adjacent to stairs; Installation of door into bedroom 2 in approved new partition wall. Adjust positioning of doorway into living room; partition between corridor and TV room at ground floor. Sliding door no longer proposed at 1st floor.
